summary: Three-channel sample generator. Loads a synthesis context from this+0x1A4, a per-channel component table base from context+0x18 (three dwords v16/v15/v13 read through it), and the per-pixel width from this+0x5C. For each of a4 pixels it advances a rolling 4-bit phase counter at context+0x30 and computes three table bases by (phase << 6) + context+0x34/+0x38/+0x3C. For each of v18 samples it sums one byte from each of three source channels, each offset by a table entry indexed by a 4-bit counter v23, and writes the accumulated byte to the destination. Writes back the advanced phase counter and returns the context pointer.

local_names.v5: component table base pointer loaded from context+0x18
local_names.v23: 4-bit sample-index counter into the phase tables
local_names.v22: destination byte pointer for the current pixel

operations.description: Load component table base v5 = result[6] (context+0x18) and read the three component offsets v16 = v5[0], v15 = v5[1], v13 = v5[2], which the fill treats as component table base pointers for channels 0/1/2.
Read per-pixel sample width v18 = *(this + 0x5C); it gates the inner per-sample loop.
If pixel count a4 is not greater than 0, skip the outer pixel loop entirely.

Outer loop over a4 pixels: capture phase v12 = result[12] (context+0x30) and destination pointer *a3, then derive three table bases v9 = (v12 << 6) + context+0x34, v8 = (v12 << 6) + context+0x38, v14 = (v12 << 6) + context+0x3C.

Inner loop over v18 samples: read one byte from each of the three source channels, each at (channel byte + phase-table entry [v9/v8/v14 + 4*v23] + additive offset v16/v15/v13); sum the three bytes and write the result to destination *v22. The table index v23 is a 4-bit counter advanced with & 0xF.
Advance the 4-bit phase counter: context+0x30 = (v12 + 1) & 0xF; persist it across pixels as generator state.
Return the synthesis context pointer result.
